purpose: Minimal source corpus for a gradual RAG learning project

extraction.normalization: Expand ff/fi/fl/ffi/ffl ligatures and collapse whitespace; preserve other characters
extraction.article_heading_handling: C5.1.18 heading is separated from body; text_raw retains it
extraction.page_numbering: pdf_page is one-based; printed_page is the visible footer label
extraction.boundary_method: Explicit article starts and next-article endpoints, not every inline cross-reference
extraction.pdf_warnings: pypdf reported recoverable object-offset warnings; the PDF was not modified

quality.assistant_visual_check: Selected records compared with Poppler renders of PDF pages 61-62
quality.text_only_limit: Layout, colour semantics, and figures are not encoded in article text; retain the original PDF
quality.scope: The five selected articles only; other downloaded PDF content is outside the corpus
